root_idea.summary: The root is organized around three semantic orientations: downward falling, rough or gritty material, and piercing or boring through something.
root_idea.development: These orientations extend to collapse and downward darting, pebbles, dust, and broken fragments, as well as perforation and defloration; derived forms also develop related senses of forceful rushing and dispersal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Canonical Quran-attested Form VII verb, normalized to its Classical Arabic perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To break apart or collapse; of a wall, to be on the point of falling down.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence describes a wall threatening to collapse, in the construction يريد أن ينقض.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bore or perforate a pearl or a piece of wood; also, to break through a pearl’s shell so as to expose and extract it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I; the pearl construction قَضَّ دُرَّةً is specifically attested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break, bray, crush, or smash something into pieces; also to demolish a wall, break the limbs or bones of prey, or sever a side from the backbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I transitive usage, including forceful breaking and separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send, impel, or disperse horses or horsemen against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Form I usage with horses or horsemen as the subject or object of attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull out a wooden pin, peg, or stake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a wooden peg or stake.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put something dry or hard, especially sugar or sugar-candy, into sawīq; by extension, to put much sugar into it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form I culinary usage with sawīq, parched-barley meal or gruel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encounter or contain pebbles or dust in or upon something, so that they trouble the teeth; of a bed, to be rough or dusty; figuratively, of anxiety, to cause disquiet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage is attested of food, flesh, places, beds, and figuratively of grief or anxiety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a bed or lying place rough and dusty, or to leave a thing covered with small pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV; the verb may be transitive or describe the resulting condition of the bed or object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crack without falling, become cut into pieces, or, of connections, become sundered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form VII extension distinct from the Quranic wall-collapse use; it includes broken connections and objects divided into pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dart or dive swiftly downward in flight to alight upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage said of a bird, especially in a pouncing or stooping movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dart or drop down, said of a star or asterism.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative or extended usage applied to a celestial body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rush swiftly against someone; of horses or horsemen, also to disperse themselves against them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage with horses or horsemen as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deflower or remove a person’s virginity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII transitive usage; the lexical definition concerns defloration without restricting the object by age or gender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To open the head or mouth of a waterskin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Form VIII usage with a waterskin as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find one’s bed or lying place rough and uncomfortable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage describing the experiencer’s perception of the bed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find grief or anxiety disquieting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative Form X usage with grief or anxiety as the source of distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break or become broken into pieces; of a group, to separate or disperse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lane’s R.Q. II form, including usage said of a company of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or land containing small pebbles or dust; by extension, pebbly or stony ground, including low sandy ground beside harder elevated ground; also something, such as food or a garment, having dust in or upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal usage describing terrain or objects marked by pebbles or dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dawn-setting of a star or asterism.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative astronomical noun, used of the setting or dawn-setting of a celestial body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Defloration; the virginity or maidenhead that is taken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting either the act of defloration or the virginity involved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broken or crushed pebbles, small pebbles, or dust, including dust spread over a bed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal mass or quasi-plural term for gritty fragments and dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small pieces of food, likened to small pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal usage based on the resemblance of food fragments to pebbles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound produced by breaking bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An action noun associated with the R.Q. I form قَضْقَضَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument used for breaking stones, resembling a woodworking adze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrumental noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant name applied to Syrian ushnān, including a slender yellow species of ḥamḍ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The botanical identification is reported with alternative descriptions.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers collapse or falling as well as cracking, cutting apart, and sundered connections.

cautions: Lane records an alternative analysis of اِنْقَضَّ in relation to نَقَضَ; the public Quranic form follows the canonical QAC root and morphology.
